events.title: Unix created at Bell Labs
events.summary: A small, portable operating system whose ideas still shape Linux, macOS, and the cloud.

narrative.whyChosen: Unix is one of the few 1960s systems whose design vocabulary is still in daily use.
narrative.whyImportant: Files, pipes, processes, and a composable tool philosophy became the default way to build software systems.
narrative.problemSolved: Early OS work was tied to specific hardware. Teams needed a simpler, portable system for real programming work.

sources.title: Bell Labs — The Creation of the UNIX Operating System
